title: On the nonnegative rank of positive operators
summary: In this paper we introduce the concept of a nonnegative rank of a positive operator $T\colon X\to Y$ between ordered vector spaces. In the case of nonnegative matrices, our definition agrees with the standard definition of a nonnegative rank. Under some natural and mild assumptions on the cone $Y_+$, we prove that the nonnegative rank and the rank agree whenever the rank is at most two. This can be considered as the infinite-dimensional version of \cite[Theorem 4.1]{CR93}.
